en: The image shows a vintage view of a grand hotel building prominently labeled 'Grand Hotel Wiesler.' The hotel is a multi-story structure with classical architectural features, situated along a tree-lined promenade or boulevard. The top of the image includes printed text with the words 'Graz' and 'Grand Hotel Wiesler.' The colors are pastel and appear hand-tinted, consistent with early 20th-century postcard styles.
